approach: I loaded the requirement-steps procedure for REQ-02, then read the four contracted inputs: feat.prebacklog, feat.intake, org.routing_map and org.architecture. I also read the organisation-level routing map named in the brief. To check for duplicates, I read every requirement file in hobasa-agentic-sdlc/requirements/, which stood in for the Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board because neither was available. I classified the entry by category (New Feature), qualifier (customer-visible, not Technical Only) and a technical sub-category per change request, each mapped to its routing owner. I compared each related item and decided whether to merge it. Nothing was merged. The sequencing overlaps are listed as non-blocking open questions. I did not run the verifier subagent. I checked the claims and numbers myself against the files I read and corrected one wording about ZD-48377. Shell use is blocked for this step (G9), so I read every file with Read.

Owner agents: the owner agent for every CR matches the feature routing map exactly.

Impacted repositories: the line lists all four repositories. That is supported by the ticket's repos list and the routing map. The note that the org-level routing map lists only ap_aging is correct.

- ZD-48211 and ZD-48501 use the rule of more than 30 days past due.
- ZD-48470 is feed v2 and adds currency.
- PROV-ACME-2026-11 moves acme-text-2 to acme-text-3 and adds a system field.
- In ZD-48377, an invoice exactly 30 days past due lands in 31-60 instead of 1-30.
- REG-LPR-2026-4.2 sets Late at more than 60 days.
- FIN-OPS-2026-07 changes max_tokens.

Decision log: the D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050 checks and lesson L-007 match memory/MEMORY.md and the prebacklog.

The outcome 'classified by category, duplicates merged' is met: the category is assigned, and the output explicitly decides there are no duplicates to merge, with reasons.
